english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for moving technology, equipment, services, or a class to a newer or better level, especially when a version change is involved.

examples.english: I want to upgrade my computer to the latest system, so it will start up much faster.
examples.traditional: 我想將部電腦升級到最新系統，開機會快好多。
